starter.original: Fresh player after basic training: AR-23 Liberator, P-2 Peacemaker, G-12 High Explosive (the onboarding chain's unlock items and the stratagems every account owns, Orbital Precision Strike and MG-43 Machine Gun, are added by ProfileStore).
starter.translation: 完成基础训练的新兵：AR-23 Liberator、P-2 Peacemaker、G-12 High Explosive（新手引导链的解锁物品，以及每个账号都拥有的战略配备——Orbital Precision Strike 与 MG-43 Machine Gun——由 ProfileStore 添加）。

unlock-all.original: Development: every non-consumable catalogue item, every booster and package progress, at the top level (300; customization needs level 10).
unlock-all.translation: 开发用：所有非消耗品目录物品、所有强化剂与数据包进度，均处于满级（300 级；自定义需要 10 级）。
